'''Brad DeFruiter''' (Brad De Fruiter) was a designer of Decipher's ''[[Star Trek CCG]]''. At [[DecipherCon 2002]] he and [[Evan Lorentz]] presented the Star Trek CCG Design-a-card Seminar for Second Edition.<ref name="dc02card">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1102stcarddesign1.html Star Trek CCG Design-a-card Seminar: Part 1], Decipher, DecipherCon 2002 Daily News (2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021221151700/http://www.decipher.com:80/deciphercon/2002/reports/1102stcarddesign1.html Internet Archive]</ref> The Second Edition rulebook (2002) credits "Second Edition Design: Evan Lorentz, Brad DeFruiter, [[Tim Ellington]]".<ref name="st2e">[http://decipher.com/startrek/rules/rulesST2E.pdf ''Star Trek'' CCG Second Edition rulebook], Decipher (2002), p. 30. Credits: "Second Edition Design: Evan Lorentz, Brad DeFruiter, Tim Ellington." Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030321233756/http://decipher.com:80/startrek/rules/rulesST2E.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> He was one of the commentators on the projected video feed of the Star Trek CCG World Championship final.<ref name="dc02stand">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1102stccgstandings.html Star Trek CCG World Championship Day Three], Decipher, DecipherCon 2002 Daily News (2002). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021106035232/http://www.decipher.com:80/deciphercon/2002/reports/1102stccgstandings.html Internet Archive]</ref>
